title: Components meeting an open subset inject into components of that open subset
statement: Let X be a topological space [def-pc-scheme] and let U be an open subset of X. The assignment C \to C \cap U sends the irreducible components C of X with C \cap U nonempty to irreducible components of the subspace U, and this assignment is injective.
